status.en: 12 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 12 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: The Supreme Court rejected President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term extension, prompting armed forces to seize the court and threaten its chief. Somali security forces opened fire on protesters in Mogadishu, killing at least three civilians in clashes over home demolitions and two in separate police shootings. Government troops were attacked near Leego town, and the Somali police deputy chief warned of a security vacuum as Ugandan troops withdraw. Egypt, Somalia and Djibouti held talks on Red Sea security and Horn of Africa stability, and the conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Høyesterett avviste president Hassan Sheikh Mohamuds forlengelse av mandatet, noe som førte til at væpnede styrker tok kontroll over retten og truet dens sjef. Somalisk sikkerhetsstyrke skjøt på demonstranter i Mogadishu, og minst tre sivile ble drept i sammenstøt om husnedrivninger, og to ble drept i separate skytinger fra politiet. Regjeringsstyrker ble angrepet nær byen Leego, og den somaliske politiets nestleder advarte om et sikkerhetsvakuum når ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake. Egypt, Somalia og Djibouti holdt samtaler om sikkerhet i Rødehavet og stabilitet på Afrikas horn, og konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
